evidence_boundary: This decision explains the current SWE-T1 task-contract boundary. It does not add task-success evidence, does not change current paper-facing main rows, and does not authorize a rerun by itself.

evidence_reviewed.finding: First-pass Summary and PaperToSkill both scored 0.000 because patches failed to apply.
Shared-source-context follow-up made both candidate patches apply, but both still failed the hidden target test.
The model-visible issue asks for a TSQL no-join alias false-positive fix.
The scorer-only hidden test patch checks a specific L031 warning-message text change rather than directly testing the no-join alias false-positive reproduction.

diagnosis.contract_mismatch: The current hidden target can reject issue-reasonable logic fixes because it primarily asserts the expected lint-message text.
diagnosis.model_visible_context_status: The phase107 source context fixed patch application but did not fix the objective mismatch.

required_properties: Both conditions use the same locked SQLFluff instance, source context, scorer, resource budget, model family, and no-mid-run-human rule.
Hidden tests directly exercise the issue reproduction queries from the model-visible issue description.
Message-text assertions may be retained only as secondary regression checks, not as the sole success criterion.
Scorer-only gold patches and hidden test patches remain hidden from model prompts.
Any replacement of the paper-facing main row requires explicit promotion through results/real_reuse/main_run_selection.json.

next_action: Do not spend more model calls on SWE-T1 under the current hidden-test contract. If the paper needs a stronger SWE-T1 row, first implement a revised issue-aligned scorer/test contract and run paired Summary/PaperToSkill conditions only after that pre-registration.
